_note: Run configuration. Copy and tune per store if needed.
_no_match_behavior: What to do when no allowed taxonomy value matches the product. 'leave_empty' (default) writes nothing for that attribute and reports it. 'use_default' writes the value named in defaults_by_attribute, and reports that a default was used. A default is only honoured when it is itself an allowed value of that attribute.

defaults_by_attribute._note: Only consulted when no_match_behavior is 'use_default'. Keyed by taxonomy attribute handle; the value is the taxonomy value NAME as it appears in the index.

_status_scope: Product statuses to include. Archived products are excluded by default.
_keep_existing_category: When true, a product that already has a category keeps it unless the proposal explicitly overrides it with a reason.
_overwrite_existing_metafields: When false, an attribute that already has a value on the product is left alone and reported as 'already_set'. When true, a proposal may replace it.
_enable_missing_definitions: standardMetafieldDefinitionEnable changes store-wide configuration, not one product. It is never called automatically. When a plan needs a definition that does not exist, the plan lists it in its own section for explicit approval; this flag only records that approval was given.
_create_missing_metaobjects: Whether the plan may propose creating metaobject entries for taxonomy values the store does not have yet. These are always listed in their own plan section and approved separately.
_metaobject_label_language: Labels for metaobjects this skill creates come from the English taxonomy name. Existing entries in other languages are never translated or renamed; they are reported as a language mismatch warning.
